items.problem: Test item "`release` while waiting on any stage ... destroys the three scene objects" uses "the three scene objects", which no defining document defines. `### lifecycle` (scene-core.md:113) lists more objects that `release` destroys: the current scene, its scene UI root, the scene created at stage 4, the loading screen, the two safe area roots, the scene holder. So a core test has no criterion for which objects to check, and two implementations can test different sets
